description: This file defines the Comment struct and associated methods for parsing, handling, and formatting comments in gettext PO files, including translator comments, extracted comments, references, flags, and previous message context and ID.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents comments associated with messages in gettext PO files, including translator comments, extracted comments, references, flags, and previous message context and ID.

methods.name: less
methods.description: Compares two Comment objects based on start line, reference files, and reference lines.

methods.name: readPoComment
methods.description: Reads and parses comments from a lineReader into the Comment struct.

methods.name: readReferenceComment
methods.description: Reads reference file and line comments starting with '#:'.

methods.name: readPrevMsgContext
methods.description: Reads previous message context comments starting with '#| msgctxt'.

methods.name: readPrevMsgId
methods.description: Reads previous message ID comments starting with '#| msgid'.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a string value from the lineReader, handling multi-line comments.

methods.name: GetFuzzy
methods.description: Checks if the 'fuzzy' flag is set in the comment.

methods.name: SetFuzzy
methods.description: Sets or unsets the 'fuzzy' flag in the comment.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Formats the Comment object into a string suitable for PO files, including all comment types and flags.
